_note: Plan 100041: ten mutants for the in-cycle battery (run_battery, _apply_battery, resolve_fold_baseline). A survivor is a missing test, stated as Critical. 0 ERROR required.

mutants.name: M1-drop-apply-battery-bar-met
mutants.why: Replacing _apply_battery at the BAR_MET arm (line 625) with a direct return bypasses all battery checks on the main closure path. A plan with plan_lint FAILs would reach BAR_MET unchecked. Test 1 (test_battery_plan_lint_fail_downgrades_bar_met) expects CONTINUE; this mutant returns BAR_MET.

mutants.name: M2-drop-plan-lint-downgrade
mutants.why: Removing the plan_lint downgrade arm means N_FAIL counts never lower BAR_MET to CONTINUE. Test 1 expects CONTINUE for a plan with lint failures; without this arm it returns BAR_MET.

mutants.name: M3-drop-fold-drift-downgrade
mutants.why: Removing the fold_check=DRIFT downgrade arm means a drifted fold never lowers BAR_MET to CONTINUE. Test 2 (test_battery_fold_drift_downgrades_bar_met) expects CONTINUE; without this arm it returns BAR_MET.

mutants.name: M4-battery-runs-on-escalate
mutants.why: Inserting an _apply_battery call before the ESCALATE:assert-fail:1 return causes battery tools to launch on ESCALATE paths. Test 7 (test_escalate_paths_skip_battery) counts subprocess launches on ESCALATE exits and expects 0; this mutant launches plan_lint + propagation_check.

mutants.name: M5-fold-check-rc2-always-vacuous
mutants.why: Removing the stdout-based VACUOUS/NO_BASELINE discrimination at rc=2 causes both states to map to VACUOUS. Test 8 (test_emit_manifest_fold_check_mapping) uses a plan with no baseline: fold_check exits rc=2 with 'FOLD-CHECK NO_BASELINE' stdout → must map to NO_BASELINE; this mutant maps it to VACUOUS.

mutants.name: M6-resolve-fold-baseline-ignore-manifest
mutants.why: Removing the manifest fold_baseline lookup causes resolve_fold_baseline to always use the beside-plan fallback. Test 10 (test_baseline_resolution_order) creates a plan with fold_baseline: pointing to a real file but no beside-plan file; expects (path, True). This mutant returns (None, False).

mutants.name: M7-resolve-fold-baseline-ignore-beside
mutants.why: Removing the beside-plan fallback causes resolve_fold_baseline to return (None, False) when no manifest field is set, even if a beside file exists. Test 10 checks that a beside-plan file is found when no manifest field is set; this mutant misses it.
mutants.anchor:
beside = plan_path.parent / f".{plan_path.name}.foldcheck.json"
    if beside.exists():
        return beside, False
    return None, False

mutants.name: M8-battery-not-appended-to-warnings
mutants.why: Removing the `warnings.append(line)` call in _apply_battery means no BATTERY: line appears in the warnings list. Test 14 (test_continue_verdict_has_no_downgrade_warn) calls run_check with warnings=[] and asserts the BATTERY: line IS present; without the append it is absent.

mutants.name: M9-battery-passed-not-run-once
mutants.why: Removing the `battery=b` argument from the run_check call in emit_manifest causes run_battery to launch tools a second time (once before run_check to build the dict, then again inside _apply_battery via run_battery(plan_path)). Test 12 (test_exactly_once_launches) counts plan_lint launches via emit_manifest and expects exactly 1; this mutant produces 2.

mutants.name: M10-one-resolver-violated
mutants.why: Adding a second inline fold_baseline lookup in run_battery (bypassing resolve_fold_baseline) breaks the ONE resolver invariant. Test 13 (test_one_fold_baseline_resolver) checks that the function call count on resolve_fold_baseline is exactly 1 per run_battery call; a second inline call raises that count.
